correctness.rationale: The first a+c output positions must have exactly a zeros: fewer prevents the first source reaching its 1-run, while more requires the second source to have passed all c leading ones. Every pair of fixed-composition blocks admits an explicit legal interleaving. Myhill–Nerode quotients are determined by residual phase composition and distinguished by compulsory remaining zeros at fixed phase length, and distinct depths are distinguished by residual length. Counting the two composition rectangles with one shared boundary and one dead state proves the exact formula for all positive parameters. Two independent finite-check algorithms corroborate 256 explicit cases and 4096 grid-automaton instances.

value.rationale: An exact complete four-parameter classification of a natural nontrivial finite-word shuffle family explains when two-dimensional interleaving nondeterminism collapses to two phases, yields a product enumeration of distinct traces, gives the entire Myhill–Nerode profile and sharp polynomial state count, and contrasts with known exponential worst cases.
